title: Down the d-File
setup: Black's king on d6 and its rook on d3 are lined up on the d-file with empty squares between them.
hint: Find the check that puts your queen on the file where the black rook is already standing, behind its king.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Qd8+}} lines the queen up in front of the king on the d-file, with the rook on **d3** trapped at the far end. The king has to step off the file, and {{Kc6}} is its only legal move — so {{Qxd3}} wins the rook.
